what: Rentokil Initial is the world's largest pest control company, operating mostly as Terminix in the United States, and it also runs hygiene services supplying washroom equipment and workwear.
customers: Homeowners and businesses on recurring pest control contracts, and offices and restaurants on hygiene services.
money: residential and commercial pest services, largely as Terminix
pest services in Europe, Asia and Latin America
moat: Pest control is bought on repeating contracts with high renewal rates, and route density means the company that already has customers on a street can serve the next one more cheaply.
risks: The Terminix integration has gone badly: technicians left and American organic growth stalled
$5.6B of debt from that acquisition against $2.3B of cash
37 times earnings for a business whose largest market is not growing
opportunities: $707M of free cash flow and analysts see about 29% upside
Pest control revenue is contractual and recurring, which is why the business is valued highly at all
If American organic growth returns to the industry rate, the margin gap with Rollins is large enough to close
watch: North American organic revenue growth, the single number that matters here.
